text:
maria: Heads-up — PagerPipe webhook -> PagerDuty started returning 502s ~10m ago, incidentbot hasn't been sending pages. Anyone seeing alerts?
jordan: seeing a spike of 502 responses from pagerpipe-proxy in the logs, looks like a bad upstream after the last deploy. cc @sre-oncall
incident-bot: system: outgoing webhook to pagerflow/pagerpipe failed (502 Bad Gateway) x5, queued 17 pages, retrying with backoff
sre-oncall: switching to manual paging while we triage. maria, can you coordinate support for customer-facing messages?
nina: I can kick off manual ringdown and SMS fallback, calling primary oncall now.
maria: support says a few customers in eu-west reported delayed alerts, trying to get list and timestamps. will post customer IDs here in a sec.
jordan: quick log dump: ```curl -v https://pagerpipe.internal/hooks/1234 \n* Connected to pagerpipe.internal (10.0.0.42) port 443 (#0)\n> POST /hooks/1234 HTTP/1.1\n> Host: pagerpipe.internal\n< HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway\n``` router -> upstream 503->502 cascade during deploy window
ops-bot: deploy-bot: redeploy of pagerpipe-proxy started by jordan (canary->stable)
sre-oncall: applying a temporary route override to send directly to PagerDuty creds: `incident-bot route override=direct-pd`
incident-bot: ack: route override applied, switching outgoing queue to direct-pd, draining queued messages (12 sent so far)
maria: update from support: 3 customer incidents missed initial automated page, all were reached via manual SMS within 6 minutes, no missed escalations reported so far. adding affected customer IDs to ticket PM-3492
jordan: creating follow-up ticket: INTG-2219 "pagerpipe-proxy: 502 under canary -> rollback/healthcheck improvements"
nina: note for postmortem: add circuit-breaker and alert on consecutive 502s from pagerpipe upstream, add a secondary route to PD for quick failover
sre-oncall: proxy redeploy finished, healthchecks pass, will leave override in place for 20m then revert if stable
maria: live mitigation looks good. please monitor outgoing-queue and notify if queued > 0 after 10m. thanks all :thumbsup:
